description:
¡Hola, amigos y colegas! 👋

Hoy haremos un recorrido rápido por algunos de nuestros productos más recientes.

Desde potentes soluciones empresariales hasta esenciales de red compactos, la nueva línea de MikroTik está diseñada para ofrecer velocidad, flexibilidad y control absoluto.
Ya sea que administres un centro de datos global, actualices tu oficina o optimices tu red doméstica - tenemos las herramientas para hacerlo más rápido, más inteligente y más confiable.

Descubre lo nuevo de MikroTik:

CRS418-8P-8G-2S+RM: Switch de nivel profesional con CPU de 4 núcleos, PoE y enlaces 10G.

RDS2216: Servidor de datos “todo en uno” con almacenamiento NVMe y red de 100G.

hEX S: Router compacto y asequible con SFP 2.5G.

ATL 5G R16: Conectividad 5G confiable, incluso en los lugares más remotos + eSIM 

LHG 5 ax / XL 5 ax: Enlaces Wi-Fi 6 de largo alcance, hasta 30 km.

SXTsq 5 ax: CPE resistente con Wi-Fi 6.

KNOT LR8 Gateway Kit: Conectividad IoT completa con LoRa®, Bluetooth y GPS.

Chateau 5G R17 ax: Wi-Fi 6 y 5G con soporte eSIM.

⚙️ Tecnología para todos los niveles - del hogar a la empresa.

add name=bridge1
port

description:

segments.transcript: Hello! Are you tired of those suspicious low-quality default routers from your mobile operators? So many households are switching to mobile internet, but those default routers could be better. So we took everything we have learned over the last 20 years of networking excellence, combined with data and feedback from real households. For those who don't know, our best friends are LMT, the leading mobile operator in Latvia. They put a Chateau in every home here. We took all that and created a single device that should satisfy 9 out of 10 households. The new default router, the new standard, the equilibrium. First stop, the raw computing power. At the end of the day, these are tiny specialized computers. A powerful CPU is important. So many homes struggle with advanced, no, even basic stuff, like encrypted VPN tunneling for secure remote work, because their router has a joke for CPU. Not the Chateau. It features a powerful modern ARM CPU with not one, not two, but four cores, and the right amount of RAM to support it. Enough processing power for all your home needs, complex firewall rules, IPsec hardware encryption, and so on. With Chateau, forget about these bottlenecks. By the way, these modern ARM CPUs support all sorts of interesting setups, like containers, tiny specialized apps running on your router. Now, at first, some might think, "Come on, all my devices are wireless. What ports?" As it turns out, there are countless scenarios when you might want that extra speed or reliability of Ethernet cables. It's even better to have good options. So, we added 5 gigabit Ethernet ports, just for good measure. Data shows that you guys always find a good use for Ethernet. While the future is definitely wireless, it's always good to have a backup plan. But let's stay on the wireless topic for now. Chateau features powerful built-in LTE antennas and the option to connect your own external LTE antennas. That's very useful if the LTE tower is too far or you need to bypass some obstacles without moving the router to where placed. My prediction? Most of you won't ever need to connect external antennas. The built-ins are good. But like I said, always nice to have good options. With Chateau, you'll never be out of options. Finally, the built-in LTE category 6 modem. Mobile network access points can get pretty expensive because of the built-in LTE modems. So, one way to keep the cost down is to stop paying for more speed than you actually need. If you took your phone out right now and did a speed test, what would it say? Well, it depends on the location, how crowded it is, where's the cell tower and so on. But our data suggests that throughout the day, the absolute majority of mobile users doesn't see speeds above 300 megabits per second. And guess what? That's more than enough for most users. For example, if you were to stream 4k movies, what would be the minimum required speed? Around 50 megabits. So, trust me, 300 megabits is still a solid speed in 2023 for most use cases. This LTE modem has one very cool feature - carrier aggregation. It allows using multiple LTE bands at the same time, automatically. That's a huge advantage when there are a lot of mobile users in the area. It offers better responsiveness in a crowded environment and higher efficiency for weaker signal situations in the countryside. We have seen internet speeds doubling in rural areas after switching to carrier aggregation, so there's absolutely no need to wait for cable network expansions. To sum things up, our Chateau gives you options. It gives you raw power to utilize your connection to the maximum. And the coolest part, if you choose MikroTik, you're getting the only product that adapts your needs at all times. Don't want to mess with configurations and learn networking? No worries. Use our handy mobile app or let the mobile operator handle everything. We'll get to that in a moment. On the other hand, if you become interested in networking, our software gives you absolute freedom. It's like a "choose your own adventure" sandbox, where the only limit is your imagination. That's why our devices are perfect for the most diverse households, from regular people who won't touch any settings, to professional system administrators, engineers, and everyone in between. And let me give you an example. I've seen my colleagues controlling their home network through the Telegram app with the help of some bot. Can you do that on those boring default routers that your mobile operator give you now? I don't think so. So once again, it's all about the options. The freedom to do anything, when, and how you have envisioned. It can be as simple or as complex as you wish. With MikroTik, you can make the choice. You can be free. Your network, your rules. And the Chateau LTE 6 kit is the perfect balanced, cost-effective doorway to your new life of excellent networking. So by now, I'm hoping that you need and want the Chateau. And how do you actually get it? The fastest way would be to simply buy it. But in most countries, the mobile operators nowadays offer free routers with their home network contracts. I think we all deserve to simply have better default routers that our mobile operators bundle with the contracts, right? Usually I would say contact your MikroTik distributor at the end of the video. But this time, ask your mobile operator if they can give you a Chateau like the LMT does in Latvia. Because that's how everyone wins, including the mobile operator. So here are top three reasons why your mobile operator will want to make the switch. First, reliable, smooth cooperation.

We're based in the European Union. We have a transparent supply chain, reputable partners for all components. MikroTik is all about predictable long-term partnership. We design our own prototypes, make our own software, assemble and test devices right here in Riga. Customization.

title: MikroTik product news: The L009 series
description:
Prices starting as low as $119!
Time to upgrade your RB2011 setups! L009 offers more features & better performance for the same low price! This product line is 2-4 times faster than RB2011, it has a modern dual-core ARM CPU with container support, an innovative enclosure that allows mounting up to four routers in a single 1U space, more RAM, PoE, and 2.5G SFP support.

segments.transcript: The legendary RB2011 product line has provided affordable, flexible and powerful connectivity for over a decade. In fact, it was our very first router with SFP. As the name suggests, we wanted to release it in 2011. But you know, good things come to those who wait. So we released it in 2012. More than a decade has passed. Finally, it is time for an upgrade. But don't worry. All the key elements and features are still there, only better. We've also managed to keep the low, low price. And we've kept your favorite color red. Dear friends, here it is. The perfect RB2011 upgrade. The L009. The first thing you might notice is the sleek form factor. Not only is it smaller than the 2011, the new case itself acts as a massive heatsink. So you can enjoy impressive performance with excellent cooling and blissful silence. Speaking of performance, don't let the size or the low price fool you. This device is a massive upgrade over the RB2011 in so many ways. First of all, we have a modern dual core ARM CPU. It offers significant improvement when it comes to routing and filtering,

complex firewall rules, IPsec hardware encryption, and all sorts of advanced routerized features. Modern ARM CPU architecture provides significant advantages over the older MIPS architecture CPUs. Like for example, it allows using all the latest Linux kernel features. We've run some tests in RouterOS version 7.8, and the L009 dominated its predecessor. Different packet sizes, various setups, fast path routing, or complex bridge filters, it doesn't matter. The L009 is up to four times faster than

the RB2011 in most cases. And you know what else is four times larger? The RAM. The DDR3L memory is faster than the previous DDR2SD RAM. By the way, there's also a full-sized USB port, so you can always add your own storage. Along with the ARM CPU, it is perfect for your container projects. Or you can use the USB to add an LTE modem of your choice. As it is often in the case of with MikroTik, only your imagination is the limit here. Now, let's take a look at the ports. All the ports are now gigabit ethernet ports, and there's another helpful addition, an SFP cage that supports both gigabit and 2.5 gigabit connectivity.

/ip firewall nat add chain=dstnat action=redirect protocol=tcp dst-port=53

title: Managing many access points with CAPsMAN (old version, up to WiFi5)
description:
=== IMPORTANT NOTE ===

This is and old video for our older devices running older RouterOS versions. If you have a 802.11ax compatible (newer) device, it uses the new Wifi CAPsMAN settings, for more information, please see: https://help.mikrotik.com/docs/display/ROS/WiFi#WiFi-WiFiCAPsMAN

=======================


UPDATE: Before you start, important note! Some devices have disabled the "local forwarding" setting in the capsman configuration template "datapath" tab. This tutorial assumes you have it checked. Some defices have different defaults, so just mark this checkbox to follow the steps in this tutorial. Local forwarding must be on! 

When you have one MikroTik access point, but want to add another one to widen your coverage, follow this tutorial and use CAPsMAN to manage as many APs as you want.

title: MikroTik product news: KNOT gateway
description:
The KNOT is an IoT Gateway for the most versatile and cost-effective setups. KNOT can monitor onboard GPIOs, convert Modbus protocol to TCP, and even forward Bluetooth packets to TCP/IP network via HTTPS and MQTT.

KNOT features so many protocol support and connectivity options: 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth, 2x 100 Mbps Ethernet ports with PoE-in and PoE-out, Micro-USB. Maximum convenience at the lowest cost!

PDF brochure: https://mt.lv/KNOT

segments.transcript: Hi, I am Valters from MikroTik. Let’s talk about Internet-of-things!   You have already seen our devices for  LoRa. We have brought the cost-effective   and flexible MikroTik approach to the IoT  world. Now it is time for the next step. KNOT is our IoT Gateway. It uses very low-bandwidth  and low-cost cellular connection for   IoT. Narrow Band and CAT-M. It is supported by  many mobile operators all over the world.   KNOT supports HTTPS and MQTT protocols  that allow sending sensor data to the   cloud or a local server. What can it do?   With the Bluetooth interface, you can use the  KNOT for asset tracking and telemetry based on

Bluetooth advertisement packets. KNOT supports any  BLE tag that sends advertisement data. iBeacon,   Eddystone or any other format. It has powerful filters for forwarding   only relevant packets and ignoring others. How would all this work in real life? Well,   let's imagine a hospital. Lots of expensive assets  moving across huge buildings. Tools, equipment,   meds, you name it. Everything gets moved around  all the time. Usually, hospitals have to spend   a lot of resources on inventory checking. Let's fix that. Place low-cost Bluetooth tags   on all the important items. Add a KNOT device in  every storage room. Now the hospital management   always knows if the equipment is returned to its  place. Why stop there? You can add temperature

segments.chapter_title: DIN rail mount included For quick and easy mounting
segments.transcript: sensors to medical supplies and use the KNOT  to keep track. The possibilities are endless.   KNOT also supports the Modbus protocol. You can  use the KNOT as a TCP bridge from wired Modbus   sensors to send readings to a Modbus server. Yes,  the KNOT brings wireless connectivity to wired   sensors, such as electricity meters and relays. As for Narrowband... The KNOT supports NB/CAT-M

Low bandwidth, low cost back-up connectivity in  case of a lost Ethernet connection. Or it could   be used as a management channel for your network.  NB/CAT-M monthly plan is much cheaper than LTE.   Why spend extra money on bandwidth you don't  need? For example, you can manage a KNOT-powered   vending machine with temperature and liquid  sensors with only a few megabytes per day!   The KNOT is a truly universal device with so  many connectivity options and protocol support.   It features 2.4 GHz wireless, two  100 Mbps Ethernet ports with PoE   in and out. And a Micro USB port. The device also has a GPIO header.   You can use it for relay control, logical  input/output sensor connectivity, voltage metering   or home automation. There is also a separate KNOT version with LoRa  support coming soon. You will be able to use it   as a LoRa gateway with NB/CAT-M connectivity. This  brings low cost connectivity for LoRa sensors in   remote locations, so stay tuned! Make sure to  check out our IoT products and start saving   time and money like never before! title: MikroTik product news: wAP ac updated model

segments.transcript: Hi! Sergejs from MikroTik here. Many of you already know the classic MikroTik wAP access point. It is weatherproof, small and really good-looking. If only it had more Gigabit Ethernet ports... Well, now it does! We have taken into account your comments and made a new, upgraded revision of this amazing device. Here is the new wAP ac. The new edition offers much better cooling and enhanced dual-band wireless performance. The antenna gain in both 2.4 and 5 GHz frequencies reaches 2.5 dBi. The antenna is omni-directional, which means - you can mount it in any direction and still have good coverage. There are 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports now. Port #1 supports PoE input, which means you can power it from a switch or the included PoE injector. This saves on cabling, and there is no need to use the power adapter. Despite the compact size, the new wAP can handle serious loads. We have doubled the RAM and added powerful quad-core CPU. All this performance, but the power consumption is now at its lowest. This unit is perfect for installation outside your house, in the garden or on your porch. Anywhere you need a capable wireless connection. The weatherproof case can be fixed to any wall. The opening in the back allows running the Etherner cable through the wall directly behind the unit. This way no cables are showing, and wAP attracts even less unwanted attention, blending into any environment. Use it on the ceiling, use it on the wall, you'll have the best connection of them all! I am definitely using the wAP ac in my home. I think you should give it a try too. By the way, it is available in two colours: black and white. Which one do you prefer? description:

title: Wireless to Wireless
description: Wireless to Wireless, Payam Poursaied (Payam, Canada). Back in 2016 MikroTik added a nice and unique feature to the RouterOS and RouterBOARDs which allows utilizing "Virtual Wireless Interface" to have simultaneously two interfaces one in AP mode and the other in Station mode on a single radio. This presentation aims to review such configuration and some of the applications which are possible based on this feature and the drawbacks. One of the main applications of this solution is securing actual clients and preventing the disclosure of them by putting the nodes behind a simple and handy RouterBOARD while connecting to a wireless network.. title: Seguridad Proactiva con MikroTik y TeamCymru
description:
Seguridad Proactiva con MikroTik y TeamCymru, Andres Genovez (NOCTELECOM, Ecuador). En esta presentación se indicará como se puede prevenir grandes ataques infraestructura mediante UTRS de TeamCymru, con colaboración de proveedores de servicio de Internet mediante el protocolo de ruteo BGP.

En esta presentación se indicará los pasos a seguir para poder enlazar mediante sesiones eBGP con TeamCymru utilizando routers Mikrotik, cómo se configuran los filtros y que medidas adicionales se pueden tomar para mitigar este tipo de ataques..  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/EC19/presentation_7188_1565813846.pdf.

title: ISP Design - Using a MikroTik CHR For Highly Available IPv4/IPv6 PPPoE Aggregation
description: ISP Design - Using a MikroTik CHR For Highly Available IPv4/IPv6 PPPoE Aggregation , Scott Hammersley (IPArchiTechs Managed Services, LLC, USA). In this presentation we will discuss using a MIkroTik CHR as a highly available PPPoE aggregation solution.  Using IPv4 and IPv6 we will explore how to design and configure multiple CHR's so that PPPoE sessions can be load balanced across two or more VM's.  We will also explore how this solution helps with scaling resources for rapidly growing subscriber counts. .

description:
Introducing  and Ideas in Fasttrack feature , Sami Haddad (Sami Abdulrahman, Lebanon). Introducing the new and interesting feature "Fasttrack"
Ideas to take advantage of fasttrack feature .  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/LB19/presentation_6676_1548664054.pdf.

title: Dude monitoring tool
description: Dude monitoring tool, Shaimaa Sharaf (Technopedia.io, Egypt). The Dude is a free application by MikroTik, which can dramatically improve the way you manage your network environment. It will automatically scan all devices within specified subnets, draw and layout a map of your networks, monitor services of your devices and execute actions based on device state changes.

title: VRRP
description:
VRRP, Farzad Heydari (Farzad Heydari, Vietnam). Describes the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) support in RouterOS.
Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) provides a solution by combining number of routers into logical group called Virtual Router (VR). VRRP implementation in RouterOS is compliant to VRRPv2 RFC 3768 and VRRPv3 RFC 5798.  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/VN19/presentation_6558_1548048558.pdf.

title: Using BCP to Create Layer 2 Networks Over the Internet
description: Using BCP to Create Layer 2 Networks Over the Internet, Faris Jawad (SMK IDN, Indonesia). Bridging a local area network through the internet is not a new idea. The interface of the MikroTik EOIP tunnel has made this easy for almost 18 years. One of the disadvantages of EOIP is that the endpoint IP address must be a public IP or tunnel must be built on a separate VPN tunnel, thus increasing packet overhead and adding additional configuration steps to create each tunnel. In this presentation, I will show BCP or Bridge Control Protocol, which is a method of bridging PPP tunnels, which provide Layer 2 connectivity (and when combined with L2TP), providing encryption in a single configuration step even when both devices have dynamic IP addresses.  PDF: https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/KH19/presentation_6561_1548331457.pdf.

title: Mikrotik Redundancy for MPLS Networks: BGP over OVPN
description: Mikrotik Redundancy for MPLS Networks: BGP over OVPN, Andrei Ivanoiu (INOVO SOLUTIONS, Romania). We have have configured and deployed an interesting setup for one of our clients that needed a failover cost-effective solution for their MPLS Networks, around 100 PoPs. We managed to deploy it with best effort internet uplinks (4G, DSL, WiMAX) & mikrotik routers that connect to HQ OVPN Mikrotik router and keep BGP sessions up over the OVPN link..  PDF: https:.

title: Benefits of MikroTik Academy for students, teachers and engineers.
description: Benefits of MikroTik Academy for students, teachers and engineers. , Veaceslav Samburschii (Academia Mikrotik Romania, Romania). The benefits that Mikrotik can give you. About the Mikrotik Academy program for students and teachers. Why training is better than a tutorial..  PDF: https:.

title: Access RouterOS using Multi-Factor Authentication
description:
Access RouterOS using Multi-Factor Authentication, Didiet Kusumadihardja (Didiet Kusumadihardja, Indonesia). With various data breach events happening in the world, we cannot rely solely on using username and password. Data breach is not only at the application level. Data breaches also occur in network devices such as MikroTik. We as network administrators must apply more security to the authentication of our MikroTik devices.

Didiet Kusumadihardja. Private Cyber Security Consultant with 12 years of experience in IT. Policy, Procedure, and Technical..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/ID18/presentation_6172_1540260014.pdf.

title: Using VRRPv3 on MikroTik
description: Using VRRPv3 on MikroTik , Parmohonan Hasibuan (SMK Taruna Bhakti Depok, Indonesia). How to use VRRPv3 on MikroTik with IPv6 Address.  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/ID18/presentation_5812_1540267475.pdf.

title: Virtual Network Design With RouterOS
description: Virtual Network Design With RouterOS, Eray HAŞAR (wirelesssistem.net , Turkey). Presenter will talk about Virtual network and will show benefits and step by step configuration examples using RouterOS. .  PDF: https:.

title: MikroTik  workshop
description: MikroTik  workshop, Yavuz Selim  (WI.COM.TR, Turkey). Virtual Metro Line. Use of simultaneous total traffic using 2 or more DSL lines. Mikrotik Bounding, L2tp and EoIP Tunneling examples..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/TR18/presentation_5480_1539843723.pdf.

title: Web content filtering and log data analysis with Mikrotik routers
description:
Web content filtering and log data analysis with Mikrotik routers, Paul Greeff (LucidView, South Africa). Web content filtering on Mikrotik routers is often performed using either layer 7 filtering, DNS filtering or a combination of both. Both have their advantages and disadvantages.

We'll explore both and show how they can be implemented on a Mikrotik router and then introduce LucidView's Big Data analysis offering as an additional option.

Log data analysis is usually performed on Netflow traffic flows exported to a log analyzer. Free and paid for options are available on the Internet. We explore some options available to Mikrotik router users and how to configure the Mikrotik router to export data to a log analyzer.

We also introduce LucidView's solution to the above and how it is different and then demonstrate how to script the Mikrotik to perform content filtering, firewall blocking and Big Data log analysis on the LucidView's cloud portal..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/TR18/presentation_6167_1539848033.pdf.

title: Mikrotik in Network Operations in NZ - Learnings and Tricks
description: Mikrotik in Network Operations in NZ - Learnings and Tricks, Alexander Neilson (Neilson Productions Limited, New Zealand). Presenting a range of network operations tricks and learnings from the trenches when using public and private L2 networks in NZ. Tricks including the triple NAT to access resistive end user devices, handling provisioning errors by LFC's, and ensuring default configuration delivered to customers address the most common customer issues. The talk will also present compatibility testing with phones and the newest Mikrotik PoE Switches..  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/NZ18/presentation_5428_1527237656.pdf.

title: DYNAFA - The Dynamic Firewall Authenticator
description:
DYNAFA - The Dynamic Firewall Authenticator, David Reeves (EIT Hawke's Bay, New Zealand).  PDF: https:https://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/NZ18/presentation_5619_1526976443.pdf.

DYNAFA is a small project I have been working on. It is a firewall based authentication system which can leverage RouterOS scheduler and script tools, as well as address lists and packet filtering. This creates an virtually impenetrable network, which can only be unlocked with the correct sequence of packets. The correct sequences are randomized and mixed together in a way which an attacker could never reproduce, even while understand the system. They are then hard coded into the firewall rules, and those rules can be altered over time, to leave only but the smallest number of ports open to attack. This minimizes attack surface significantly ( less 0.02 % ), counters port scans and probes ( Dynamic attack surface ), counters replay attacks ( Dynamic Authentication Requirements ) stings attackers with booby-traps within the authentication surface topology ( High risks of being blacklisted ), is resource efficient ( Negative filtering ) and near impossible to crack with brute force

title: Fast forwarding VLANs and RoMon management on MikroTik Point-to-Point radio
description:

A - Build bridged VLANs for customer data access and ISP management on a MikroTik Point-to-Point radio links
B - Show how to enhance fast packets forwarding without broadcasting radio MAC Addresses on RouterOS 6.41
C - How to remotely take control of a MikroTik radio when neighboring and management IP addresses are disabled.  PDF: https:.

Leveraging Mikrotik in the cloud for fun and profit, Marc Perea (MCP Networks LLC, USA). Marc Perea will host a workshop based around the cloud hosted router (CHR) by MikroTik. His talk will include a follow along walk-through on installing CHR on Amazon Web Services (AWS) followed by several potential use cases and one case study.

title: VLAN in MikroTik
description:
VLAN in MikroTik, Muhammad Fathan Mubina (SMK  Madinatul Qur'an, Indonesia). You can use MikroTik RouterOS to mark these packets as well as to accept and route marked ones.

As VLAN works on OSI Layer 2, it can be used just as any other network interface without any restrictions. VLAN successfully passes through regular Ethernet bridges.

You can also transport VLANs over wireless links and put multiple VLAN interfaces on a single wireless interface. Note that as VLAN is not a full tunnel protocol (i.e., it does not have additional fields to transport MAC addresses of sender and recipient), the same limitation applies to bridging over VLAN as to bridging plain wireless interfaces. In other words, while wireless clients may participate in VLANs put on wireless interfaces, it is not possible to have VLAN put on a wireless interface in station mode bridged with any other interface.. Keeping your rack cool with one /ip route rule, Marek Isalski (Faelix Limited, United kingdom). Thousands of bots are hammering your IP addresses with brute-force password attempts, DDoS attacks, and other unwanted traffic.  Don't want the bad guys to waste CPU cycles on your servers?  Marek will explain how Faelix Limited integrated intrusion detection systems, fail2ban, FastNetMon, and other systems with some MikroTik CCRs at our network edge.

This presentation covers our experience with MikroTiks in the default-free zone, common abuse traffic patterns, honeypots, and some ideas how to help black-hat SEO "comment spam" consultants transition to a more ethical form of employment..  PDF: http://mum.mikrotik.com/presentations/UK16/presentation_3885_1479296620.pdf.

offering higher educational institutions the possibility to
organize Networking classes using RouterOS as a

recognized certificate (MTCNA) that confirms their
academic credentials.... Let's go through the benefits & Requirements for establishing Mikrotik Academy (in your Educational Institution).

title: Design and Implement VLAN Translations/Rewrites using Switches and Routers
description: Design and Implement VLAN Translations/Rewrites using Switches and Routers, Kevin Myers (IP ArchiTechs Managed Services, USA). This presentation will highlight the use cases of VLAN Translations in real world environments to include Data Center, Enterprise and Service provider/WISP. Design and implementation will be covered using RouterBoard routers and CRS switches. Verification of VLAN Translation will also be covered using the sniffer tool and Wireshark..

title: Cloud Core Router product details
description:
The Cloud Core Router is an industrial grade router with a cutting edge 36 core Tilera CPU. Unprecedented power and unbeatable performance - this is our new flagship 
device. 20 times faster than our previous top model, the Cloud Core can throughput up to 24 million packets per second, or up to 16 gigabits. This is full wire speed. 

The device comes in a 1U rackmount case, has four SFP ports, twelve Gigabit ethernet ports, serial console and a USB port. A color touchscreen displays device status, traffic graphs, or provide access to simple configuration options. 

The device has two SODIMM slots, by default it is shipped with 4GB of RAM, but has no memory limit in RouterOS, so will accept and utilize 16GB or more. 

The cloud core router is powered by RouterOS, a fully featured routing operating system which has been continuously improved for fifteen years. Dynamic routing, hotspot, firewall, MPLS, VPN, advanced quality of service, load balancing and bonding, real-time configuration and monitoring - just a few of the vast number of features supported by RouterOS. 

The cloud core router is ready for any situation, for any load.

Buy here: http://www.mikrotik.com/buy
